title: Vampire Vape Tropical Passionfruit Splash 100ml Shortfill E-Liquid
description: Passionfruit Splash 100ml Shortfill from Vampire Vape’s Tropical collection serves up an exotic mix of Curuba, Passionfruit and Banana for a layered and satisfying vape. Curuba leads with a tangy, citrus-peach character, while Passionfruit adds a tropical burst of sweet and tart complexity. Banana finishes the blend with a smooth, creamy note that softens and unifies the fruit medley. Blended at 70VG/30PG, this e-liquid is ideal for DTL (direct-to-lung) vaping using sub-ohm kits and high-powered devices. Add two 10ml nicotine shots to adjust the strength to suit your preference. Vampire Vape e-liquids are crafted in the UK and known for their quality, bold flavour blends and reliability. The Tropical range brings adventurous flavour combinations into the spotlight. Also available in Nic Salt, Freebase and Concentrate formats.
